title: Bochner integrals over an injective continuous image from a weighted set identity (supplied steps 5–6)
statement: Let m, P ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra), G : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, J : ℝ^m → ℝ measurable and A ⊆ ℝ^m measurable (ℝ^d = Euclid d). Assume G is continuous on A and injective on A, J(w) ≥ 0 for w ∈ A, and μ(G(B)) = ∫_B J dL^m for every measurable B ⊆ A, where the right side is the lower Lebesgue integral of ENNReal.ofReal∘J with respect to L^m = volume. Then for every f : ℝ^P → ℝ (no measurability or integrability assumed), ∫_{G(A)} f dμ = ∫_A J(w)·f(G(w)) dw. Both sides are Bochner integrals, so a non-integrable function has integral 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (J : Euclid m → ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid m)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet A → ContinuousOn G A → InjOn G A → Measurable J → (∀ w ∈ A, 0 ≤ J w) → (∀ B : Set (Euclid m), MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ A → μ (G '' B) = ∫⁻ w in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J w)) → ∫ y in G '' A, f y ∂μ = ∫ w in A, J w * f (G w)
